notes.title: Patch 1.2
notes.notes:
- Added a new free Zaza pack.
- Fixed a bug where clicking multiple times on a piece would cause skipping a turn.
- Fixed a bug where promotion would not spawn a piece.
- Fixed a bug where promotion box would also be visible to the enemy, causing the enemy to interfere the promotion process.

notes.title: Patch 1.1
notes.notes:
- The board perspective has been remade. This means if that your pieces will be now always on the bottom of the screen (like every other chess game). If you don't like this feature, you can always change perspective by pressing F2.
- Added emoticons to increase the game's toxicity.
- You can only exchange card per match.
- Fixed a missing material issue for the Winter Pack.
- Fixed a bug where exchanging one pawn for card would sometimes not work.

notes.title: Hotfix 0.1
notes.notes: - Fixed a bug where the board and the pieces would not show
